description: This file defines a React context provider component 'TaskProvider' that manages task-related state and actions within a task management application. It handles task selection, expansion, sorting, category updates, and UI state such as modals and menus.

methods.name: toggleShowMore
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of a task identified by taskId.

methods.name: handleSelectTask
methods.description: Handles selection and deselection of a task.

methods.name: highlightMatchingText
methods.description: Highlights parts of text that match the current search term.

methods.name: handleDeleteTask
methods.description: Opens the delete task confirmation dialog.

methods.name: handleCloseMoreMenu
methods.description: Closes the context menu and resets body overflow style.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates category information across categories and tasks.
